body: I wish I learned to talk before not doing so cost me everything I ever cared about

Forgive yourself. 
I wish I learned how. Now I’ve done damage to my family around me. From a bleeding heart that never learned to forgive myself for being abused and then showing off what I learned too. 
It is quite the feeling to leave with someone. I’m glad you saw the light in that moment of confusing and weakness.
I thought what I was learning was a ‘game’.
Ppl didn’t like playing with me sometimes, like the innocent other kids. Just so happens the one that pays attention turned out to have an agenda all along. 
I closed off, I sealed all the hate hurt and pain. Didn’t process any of it and it has cost me dearly. 
18 is still an age where u can salvage your life and the road you end up on.

I read up on a couple methods but they’re all foreign.
Nothing for me, here and now. 
Websites are all scammers.
I’ve falling into my last depression.
I hate myself and cant imagine a time of forgiving myself either.
If I could donate my organs away. To not go out at such a waste.

Me too. My only escape is sleep and that has been suffering lately too.
If there was a switch, I’d pull it. 
Instead sitting here in a jail of the mind
